card.text: A star 76% of the Sun's width that turns once in 7.13 days, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Folsom et al. give it 0.76 solar radii, 0.85 solar masses, a rotation period of 7.13 days and an axis tilted 77° from the line of sight.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field-2015-09.title: Radial field, Sep 2015
radial-field-2015-09.summary: The star's magnetic field, mapped in this project from archived spectra by how it polarises starlight.

corona-sep-2015.title: Derived corona, Sep 2015
corona-sep-2015.summary: Derived here from the field mapped in Sep 2015. Brightness follows density at each distance.
